reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for my eyelashes, facials, IV therapy, and eyebrows, and I couldn’t be happier. It’s truly a one-stop shop for all my beauty and wellness needs. The team is professional, welcoming, and always does an amazing job. I always leave feeling refreshed and looking my best. Highly recommend!

I am absolutely obsessed with J Studio! Every time I see Leilani for my lash lift I leave beyond impressed, the results never disappoint. You can tell this team really knows what they're doing, super professional and experienced. I wouldn't trust anyone else!

I absolutely love this beauty studio. Everyone is so welcoming, kind and helpful. Beautiful and clean place. Genuinely such a safe space to glow up and feel amazing about yourself. Diane is so incredibly talented. Highly recommend.
